notes.title: English translation update!!!
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your patience!
We've finished proofreading and improving the quality of English texts!
If you have any feedback on the English text, please post it in the forum.

In addition, the following content has also been updated.
・Improved UI graphics
・Adjustment of insert graphics

Development is still ongoing!
I'd love for you to post your thoughts and reviews so we can further improve the quality!

Thanks to the following staff!

English proofreading
José Pedro Fernandes

English review
Andy Hare

notes.title: Pricedown and update plan news!
notes.content:
The selling price has been significantly reduced!
(Considering the results of recent sales and normal sales, we changed the price to a value that we judged to be appropriate.)
And, we will make improvements and updates based on the reviews so far.
Please let us know the good points and bad points in your review (or comment)!

・ Future update schedule

1. Change the facial expression animation so that text skipping does not stop
2. Change to start text skipping in interrogation mode
3. Install a "full screen / normal" change button on the game setting screen
4. Change to open the "game setting screen" from the setting button during game play
5. Express parentheses such as "「」『』【】" in English version with colored text

・ Planned update
Improved English translation
* We are currently recruiting staff!

notes.title: Update of ver1.3
notes.content:
1. The log screen has been made easier to see "Index" and "Details"!
When you select an item, the other side will scroll to that place!

2. "Log Hint" have been added to important log!
This is a hint that Patrick gives for "hard to notice", use it for deduction!

notes.title: Update of ver1.2
notes.content:
Hi, games are easier to play!
1. On the result screen of facial expression analysis, the type of facial expression is displayed in animation, and information about the true/false type is also added.
2. I've added and added some points to the scenarios.
3. Bug fixes and other minor improvements.

notes.title: Update of ver1.1
notes.content:
Added "Entrust" to "Facial Expression Discovery Mode" to fully automate the analysis.
"Characteristics and movements" have been added to the "expression model".
Added "View again" button on the result screen of facial expression analysis.
Reduce the font size of the log screen.
Speed up text auto mode.
Increased "life recovery amount" during breaks.
